sum: HUB Cyber Security Ltd. provides cyber security solutions in Israel, the Americas, the Asia Pacific, and Europe. The company operates in two segments, Product and Technology and Professional Services. It develops and markets integrated cybersecurity hardware/software solutions, including data and cybersecurity, system security, reliability solutions, and related services, such as consulting, planning, training, integrating, and ongoing servicing of cybersecurity, risk management, system quality, reliability and security projects, and fully managed corporate cybersecurity services. The company also provides ALD Software, a software suite for the safety and reliability analysis software for civil and military aviation, communication, space, and electronics organizations; RAM Commander, a reliability and safety software that covers engineering tasks related to reliability of electronic, electro-mechanical, and mechanical systems; Safety Commander, a software that provides fail-safe design for any system of system safety assessment across multiple industries; and FavoWeb FRACAS, an ALD web-based and user-configurable failure reporting, analysis, and corrective action system. In addition, the company offers ALD College, offers various courses in the areas of quality and reliability for private participants and institutions; outsourcing services; and secured data fabric and confidential computing. Further, it provides tech solutions and consulting, such as software development and testing, cybersecurity, information systems, consulting, and training for large enterprises, militaries, and government agencies. HUB Cyber Security Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
ceo: Mr. Nir  Bar-Eli (Chief Executive Officer of Comsec Global)
